name: 21215 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21215 (Baltimore) has 375 nonprofit organizations. 137 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21215 (Baltimore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21215 (Baltimore) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
